items.text: galat amount hai
payment already hua
charge match nahi karta

items.context: Kya aap amount confirm kar sakte hain?
items.text: thoda revise karo

items.context: Kya aapko outstanding balance dikh raha hai?
items.text: yeh galat lag raha hai

items.context: Kya aapne payment kiya tha is mahine?
items.text: check kar lo
mera outstanding amount bilkul sahi nahi hai
maine payment time pe kar diya tha par fir bhi amount hai
aapke records mein galti ho sakti hai please check karo
maine already poora paisa transfer kar diya tha kal
extra charge lagaya hua hai jo mujhe samajh nahi aaya
apka system mera payment show nahi kar raha hai
main kehta hoon ki amount mujhe thoda zyada lag raha hai

items.context: Kya aapne payment recent kiya hai?
items.text: maine kal payment kiya tha par ab bhi balance hai

items.context: Kya aapko koi additional fees dikh rahi hain?
items.text: extra charges lag gaye hain jo maine pay nahi kiye

items.context: Aapko apne statement mein kya problem lag rahi hai?
items.text: please apne records dubara verify karo ye galti lagti hai

items.context: Kya aapne recent transactions dekhe hain?
items.text: maine 5000 rupaye pay kiye the lekin amount 7000 dikha raha hai

items.context: Kya aapko koi new charges dikh rahe hain?
items.text: yeh charge kabhi apply nahi hua tha pehle se
maine observe kiya hai ki mera outstanding amount last wale bill se zyada dikh raha hai aur mujhe samajh nahi aa raha ki kyun itna extra charge lag raha hai
maine to last mahine time par full payment kiya tha lekin aaj call karne par mujhe bataya ja raha hai ki abhi bhi amount pending hai ye kaise hua mujhe samjhayein
mera account mein 2000 rupaye ka charge unexpected laga hai, ye shayad galti se hua hai kyunki mai hamesha apna payment time par karta hoon

items.context: Kya aap last payment date ke baare mein confirm kar sakte hain?
items.text: maine last payment 15 March ko kiya tha fir bhi mera balance kam kyun nahi hua hai

items.context: Kya aap apni current outstanding balance ke baare mein bata sakte hain?
items.text: aapke system ke hisaab se mera outstanding amount 15000 hai par maine confirm kiya tha ki ye poora clear ho chuka hai

items.context: Kya aap apne recent charges ke baare mein kuch kehna chahenge?
items.text: maine notice kiya ki kuch aise charges lag rahe hain jo mere agreement mein nahi the, mujhe explanation chahiye ye charges kyu hain

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: collections
Intent: dispute_amount - says the outstanding amount or a charge is wrong
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
